phase: 5C.11 joint Euclidean direct-TOA and first-order reflection experiment

model.direct_gauges: m1=(0,0,0); m2 on +x; m3 in xy with positive y; e1=0
model.wall_parameterization: 12 azimuth/elevation parameters and six log support gaps; offsets derived from current endpoint point support with the C9/C10 numerical clearance floor
model.residual_scaling_and_weights: Direct and echo TOA residuals are both multiplied by known c, converting seconds to distance-equivalent metres. Every individual observation has unit weight; the 390 echo terms are not normalized down to the 65 direct terms. No regularization or face-penalty residual is used.
model.assignment: Within each known microphone/source event group, sort predicted and observed six scalar arrival sets. For squared residual this is the globally optimal one-to-one assignment by the rearrangement inequality. Assignment is recomputed at every residual evaluation.
model.physical_checks: Containment follows the C9 support-gap parameterization. Bounded convexity, positive path lengths/arrivals, and finite-face bounce points are separate acceptance diagnostics, not weighted residual terms.
model.optimizer: SciPy least_squares TRF; analytic existing direct block Jacobian plus forward finite-difference echo block Jacobian (relative parameter step 1e-6); x_scale=jac; tolerances 1e-11; max_nfev=80.
model.full_jacobian: Optimizer Jacobian for stacked 455 distance-equivalent residuals and all 83 parameters; numerical rank threshold 1e-8 relative to largest singular value.
